findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_package_details" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Fetch the full itinerary, descriptions, included attractions, optional add-ons, pricing notes, and booking pathway for one Sparkling Tracks tour package by id. …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_packages, get_package_details, search_all_tours, list_destinations, get_affiliate_services, get_contact_info, get_careers, get_reviews · Private data: get_package_details, get_contact_info, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary · Public sink: get_package_details, get_contact_info, get_careers, check_departure_live, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary, send_whatsapp_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_packages, get_package_details, search_all_tours, list_destinations, get_affiliate_services, get_contact_info, get_careers, get_reviews · Private data: get_package_details, get_contact_info, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary · Public sink: get_package_details, get_contact_info, get_careers, check_departure_live, request_to_book, request_custom_itinerary, send_whatsapp_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
